name: How do you determine the market value of a vacant house?

mainEntity.name: How do you determine the market value of a vacant house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The market value of a vacant house is determined by evaluating comparable recently sold properties in the area, considering its condition, size, features, and location. Kelby Contreras conducts a thorough comparative market analysis (CMA) to assess these factors against current market trends in areas like Miami-Dade, Broward, or Palm Beach County. We also factor in any unique attributes of the property or the neighborhood that might influence its appeal or value. This data-driven approach helps set a competitive and realistic asking price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Market value for a vacant house is determined through a comparative market analysis (CMA) that considers recent sales, condition, size, features, and location. This helps set a realistic asking price.
